fact: The World Bank's implementation status report of 19 December 2025 records the indicator 'Implementation of integrated EMIS' as No at 5 December 2025 (target Yes by July 2030), zero dashboards published and 'No integrated EMIS available' at 17 December 2025, with only 'initial steps' taken towards the EMIS result since TRESOR became effective on 17 March 2025.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Transforming the Education Sector for Better Outcomes and Results (TRESOR) (P179410), Seq No: 4
